A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
three-body interactions in lattice chiral EFT are well-defined and can be determined using the finite-volume method and Monte Carlo methods.
we have computed the three- and four-body interactions in chiral effective field theories at next-to-next to-leading order.
we are able to reproduce all the low-energy scattering phase shifts and the energy of the deuteron and $ \alpha$-particle with a relative accuracy of 0.2% and 1%, respectively.
The main takeaway from our work is that
lattice QCD can be a powerful tool for studying few-nucleon systems at next-to-next-leading order.
three-body forces are important for describing the triton, and the $ \alpha $ -particle, but are not important for describing the low-energy neutron-deutron phase shifts.
three-body forces are necessary to achieve quantitative agreement between lattice calculations and experiment.
